name: GitHub issue to PR
description: Implement ready GitHub issues, address pull request feedback, and publish tested changes for review.
exampleImplementation: A scheduled scanner selects every ready issue and each pull request whose exact head failed review. It submits one idempotent subject turn for each item. The profile-backed agent then clones the repository in its own runtime, implements or revises the change, tests it, pushes it, and requests independent review.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to look for newly labelled issues.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Timezone the schedule is interpreted in.

repositories.label: Repositories
repositories.help: Repositories to scan. Eligible issues are delegated independently so several agents can work in parallel.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: Only issues carrying this label are worked on.

branchPrefix.label: Branch prefix
branchPrefix.help: Branches are named after this prefix and the issue number, such as openhands/issue-42.

pullRequestMode.label: Pull request mode
pullRequestMode.help: Whether the pull request is opened as a draft or ready for review.

githubTokenSecret.label: GitHub token secret
githubTokenSecret.help: Name of a saved secret allowed by the selected agent profile. Enter its name, not its value.

setup.message: Configure the repositories, labels, branch prefix, pull request mode, agent profile, and schedule.
